Name: Pokemon Day Care - Resources
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Resources[/b][/size]

Part of the Pokemon Day Care collection. This mod retextures the world's natural resources so your farm, forests and mines look like a Pokemon game.

[b]What changes[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Tall grass[/b] - cuttable grass becomes Pokemon tall grass, with autumn colours in fall and snow in winter. Blue grass gets the same look in its own blue shades.[/*]
[*][b]Weeds[/b] - one single Pokemon-style tuft, recoloured for each season, for the mines (olive green, purple in the lava levels) and for the green rain.[/*]
[*][b]Stones[/b] - farm and quarry stones (snowy in winter), every mine stone and its rubble in each floor's colours, and the Ginger Island volcano stones.[/*]
[*][b]Boulders[/b] - the farm boulder (snowy in winter) and the mine boulders (earth and ice).[/*]
[*][b]Wood[/b] - large stump, large log (snowy in winter) and twigs, in a darker brown.[/*]
[*][b]Ore and gem nodes[/b] - copper, iron, gold, iridium, radioactive, mystic, coal, the gem node and the 7 gem nodes, the 4 geode stones, volcano nodes, cinder shards, fossil, clay, mussel and Calico egg stones.[/*]
[*][b]Meteorite[/b] - becomes a cluster of purple crystals.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Configuration[/b]
Every part has its own on/off option: tall grass, blue grass, weeds, small stones, mine stones, ore and gem nodes, twigs, boulder, mine boulders, stump, log and meteorite. Edit config.json, or use Generic Mod Config Menu.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
Works on its own or with the other Pokemon Day Care mods. Other mods that retexture the same things (grass, stones, nodes...) will conflict. This mod loads its changes late, so it usually wins; disable the matching option if you prefer the other mod's look. Saplings, trees, fruit trees and the rock crabs are not changed.

[b]Translations[/b]
English, French.
